description: This script generates target configuration and profile makefiles based on target metadata, parsing complex nested data structures and producing configuration scripts.

methods.name: target_config_features
methods.description: Generates configuration feature strings based on input feature list.

methods.name: target_name
methods.description: Returns a formatted name for a target, including parent if present.

methods.name: kver
methods.description: Converts version strings to a standardized format for comparison.

methods.name: print_target
methods.description: Prints configuration entries for a given target, including dependencies and features.

methods.name: merge_package_lists
methods.description: Merges two package lists, removing duplicates and handling negations.

methods.name: gen_target_config
methods.description: Main function to generate the target configuration script from metadata.

methods.name: gen_profile_mk
methods.description: Generates profile-specific makefile entries based on target metadata.

methods.name: parse_command
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and invokes appropriate generation functions.
